review.limits: Contact sheets do not certify every product page or every responsive crop. The enlarged product image uses contain; primary gallery images use cover.

findings.note: Replaced the unrelated console cover with Horizon wall art. Full wall panel remains identifiable in saved desktop/mobile previews.
Entryway is a bench and fits the chairs-and-benches article. It was not changed.

Wide candidate crops cut parts of tall chairs, standing sculptures, pendants and clocks. Preserve portrait/contain presentation when full shape matters; do not use the wide comparison as an approved cover for every asset.
River Channel remains repeated in journal planning articles. The inventory lists all assignments for deliberate cover selection.
The maker image and design renderings remain visualizations; no claim of actual staff, completed customer work or physical product photography was added.
